questions.question: Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as are the two words in the following word-pair. Bread ∶ Wheat
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as are the two words in the following word-pair.

Bread ∶ Wheat
questions.solution:
Given: Bread : Wheat 

The logic followed here is:

Wheat is the key ingredient to make Bread.

Similarly,

Tomato is the key ingredient to make Sauce.

Hence, sauce : tomato is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. Butter : Milk :: Oil : ?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Butter : Milk :: Oil : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

Butter : Milk → Butter is obtained from milk.

Similarly,

Oil : ? → Oil is obtained from oil seeds (endosperm) of some plants.

Hence, ‘seed’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: ‘Disease’ is related to ‘Pain’ in the same way as ‘Accident’ is related to ‘______’.
questions.questionHtml: ‘Disease’ is related to ‘Pain’ in the same way as ‘Accident’ is related to ‘______’.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

‘Disease’ causes ‘pain’.

‘Accident’ causes ‘injury’ whereas ‘collision’, ‘carelessness’ and ‘driving’ are causes of ‘accident’.

Hence, the correct answer is Injury.
